precopy_order.instructions: For the selected txbuf_min_size branch in airoha_npu_load_firmware, is airoha_npu_wlan_prepare_request checked for failure before either firmware request and before either memcpy_toio?

request_field.instructions: Does airoha_npu_wlan_prepare_request derive request.start and native_plan[5][0] from priv->npu.cores[0].addr rather than a fixed fixture or the virtual core->buf pointer?

incomplete_plan.instructions: Considering airoha_npu_run_firmware resets native_plan_ready, does a run with wlan_memory_count != 4 keep native_plan_ready false through airoha_npu_wlan_prepare_request?

physical_drain.instructions: Does airoha_npu_wlan_prepare_request itself perform any physical engine reset or DMA drain, instead of only checking geometry and storing private metadata?

failed_load_plan.instructions: Does the invalidate path in airoha_npu_load_firmware clear the private request/plan validity flags and private metadata when ret is nonzero?
